Silver — a pixel font for games
Author : Poppy Works
Source : https://poppyworks.itch.io/silver
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)
         Credit "Poppy Works" wherever the font is used (in-game credit line on the Title screen).

         (see the itch.io page for details).

Measured from this copy of Silver.ttf (Version 1.0, downloaded 2026-11-21):
  unitsPerEm 1900, 100 units = 1 pixel  ->  native size 19 px (use multiples: 19, 38, 57, 76, 95 ...)
  cap height 9 px, ascent 12 px, descent 9 px (line height 21 px)
  13,792 glyphs: Hangul syllables 2,358 (common set), Hiragana/Katakana full, CJK ideographs 8,377
